glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形). The oracle bone script form consisted of two strings with cowries attached. Some forms of the oracle bone script contained an additional 人 which later evolved into 勹, which served as a phonetic component. The glyph was eventually corrupted to a duplication of 月 (“moon”). Shuowen erroneously suggests 朋 was the ancient form of 鳳.
shuowen: Shuowen erroneously suggests 朋 was the ancient form of 鳳.
